body:
## Pull request overview

Redesigns the report designer workflow to align with the dashboard-style config panel pattern, while improving the report preview’s responsiveness to config changes and expanding report interactivity (grouping, conditional formatting, chart config).

**Changes:**
- Extend report types to support `reportType`, `conditionalFormatting`, and `chartConfig` on `ReportSchema`.
- Add client-side grouping + conditional formatting styling in `ReportViewer`.
- Rework `ReportView` live preview/data fetching and expand `ReportConfigPanel` with field picker, chart editor, conditional formatting builder, sections manager, and undo/redo.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/reports.ts | Adds `ReportType`, `reportType`, `conditionalFormatting`, and `chartConfig` to report types. |
| packages/types/src/index.ts | Exports `ReportType` from the types barrel. |
| packages/plugin-report/src/ReportViewer.tsx | Implements client-side grouping + conditional formatting cell styling. |
| packages/plugin-report/src/ReportConfigPanel.tsx | Adds dashboard-style config sections (columns picker, chart config, conditional format rules, sections manager) + undo/redo wiring. |
| apps/console/src/components/ReportView.tsx | Fixes live preview/data refetch triggers and regenerates preview sections (but currently overwrites user sections). |
| packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/ReportViewer.test.tsx | Adds tests for grouped rendering and conditional formatting styling. |
| packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/ReportConfigPanel.test.tsx | Adds tests for new panel sections and interactions (type selector, field picker, undo/redo, chart/cf/sections UI). |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the redesigned report designer items as completed. |
</details>

The data fetch effect uses `dataFetchSource.sort` in the query (`$orderby`), but `sort` isn’t included in the effect dependency list. Changing sort order in the config panel won’t trigger a re-fetch, so the preview can show stale ordering. Include `dataFetchSource.sort` (or a memoized `sortKey` like the existing `filtersKey`) in the dependency array.

The “remove rule” control is an icon-only button without an accessible name. Add an `aria-label` (or an `sr-only` text node) so screen readers can announce what the button does.
```suggestion
            data-testid={`cf-rule-remove-${idx}`}
            aria-label="Remove rule"
```

The section reorder buttons render as ▲/▼ with no accessible label. Add `aria-label` (e.g., “Move section up/down”) so keyboard/screen-reader users can understand these controls; also consider using a consistent icon button component if available.

The “remove section” control is an icon-only button without an accessible name. Add an `aria-label` (or `sr-only` text) so assistive tech can announce it properly.
```suggestion
            data-testid={`section-remove-${idx}`}
            aria-label="Remove section"
```
